title: CLTR Cutover AuthorityEpoch record
description: Phase 136J, Implementation Group 2. Shape-only wire contract for an AuthorityEpoch companion record (CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 v1.0 Sec.17). An AuthorityEpoch document identifies one migration-epoch-scoped authority lineage node: proposed, active, or superseded. Schema validity never establishes that the described epoch exists, is currently active, or is production authority (Sec.1, Sec.40). Legacy lifecycle remains the sole production authority; CLTR remains derivative. authority_role "authoritative" is forbidden on this record: an epoch identifies a lineage node, never a resolved live-authority claim, which belongs to authority_state.schema.json only (Sec.9).

schema_id.description: Always present. Identifies this document as validated against the AuthorityEpoch schema.

schema_version.description: Always present. This file's own MAJOR.MINOR version.

contract_version.description: Always present. CLTR-CUTOVER-EXECUTABLE-SCHEMAS-001 version this schema was generated against.

record_type.description: Always present. Fixed family tag for this record type.

record_id.description: Always present. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

record_digest.description: Always present. Digest of this document itself. Shape-checked only; never recomputed at Layer 2.

created_at.description: Always present. Never used to establish record identity or ordering across documents.

migration_epoch.description: Always present. The opaque migration-epoch token this AuthorityEpoch node belongs to.

authority_kind.description: Always present. Whether this epoch node describes a legacy-authority or cltr-authority lineage.

activation_state.description: Always present. Record-local ActivationState. "proposed" epochs must not carry a generation_binding; "active" epochs must. "superseded" marks a formerly active epoch now retired from currency; schema shape alone cannot verify that a superseded epoch is no longer resolved as live authority (Layer 4/6).

predecessor_epoch.description: Always present as a key; value is null only for the first epoch of a migration lineage, otherwise a family-tagged reference to the immediately preceding AuthorityEpoch record. Family-restricted to authority_epoch to prevent a differently-typed record masquerading as a predecessor epoch.

generation_binding.description: Conditionally present: required when activation_state is "active", forbidden when activation_state is "proposed". A valid reference never implies the referenced generation is certified or authoritative (Layer 4/6).

authority_disclosure.description: Always present. authority_role "authoritative" is locally forbidden on this record (see file description); is_authoritative remains const false per the shared definition regardless.

epoch_reference.description: A record_reference locally restricted to record_family "authority_epoch", preventing a differently-typed record reference from being substituted as a predecessor epoch.
